zh-CN.title: 运行复盘
zh-CN.description: 把一次已封存运行的事件证据整理成时间线、异常清单与可分享的 Markdown 报告，用来回答“这次为什么失败/卡住”。

usage.title: 安装并授权
usage.description: 通过 make extension-install 安装示例，在 config.yaml 的 plugins 中授予 host_access.evidence 后重启 Gateway。

usage.title: 查看单次运行报告
usage.description: 调用 /api/extension-run-postmortem/runs/{thread_id}/{run_id} 获取结构化复盘，或在末尾追加 /markdown 下载可分享报告。

usage.title: 先看异常再读时间线
usage.description: anomalies 汇总部分封存、错误事件、护栏触发、交付未完成、工具失败与证据截断；timeline 则是按事件序号展开的执行轨迹。

requirements: 需要持久化 run store 与数据库事件存储（run_events.backend: db）。
需要在 config.yaml 中显式授予 host_access.evidence。

en-US.title: Run postmortem
en-US.description: Turns one sealed run's event evidence into a timeline, an anomaly list and a shareable Markdown report that answers "why did this run fail or stall".

usage.title: Install and grant access
usage.description: Install the example with make extension-install, grant host_access.evidence in config.yaml plugins, then restart Gateway.

usage.title: Open a run report
usage.description: Call /api/extension-run-postmortem/runs/{thread_id}/{run_id} for the structured report, or append /markdown for a shareable document.

usage.title: Read anomalies before the timeline
usage.description: anomalies summarizes partial sealing, error events, guardrail hits, incomplete delivery, tool failures and truncated evidence; timeline expands the run by event sequence.

requirements: Requires a durable run store and the database event store (run_events.backend: db).
Requires an explicit host_access.evidence grant in config.yaml.
